title: 第二十一章   客满
content_zh:
“依依姐，我们赶快去吃午饭啊，别管他了。”孙依诗见这个叫郑乔文一直不依不挠的跟苏林依聊天，有些忍不住了，不满道

    “郑乔文不好意思，我们要去吃饭了，再见。”说着苏林依便拉着孙依诗准备进入餐馆

    不过郑乔文好不容易遇到了苏林依，自然不会浪费这样的机会。

    “苏林依，好巧啊，我也没吃午饭呢，要不一起吃吧，我请客。”郑乔文赶忙说道

    过了片刻，郑乔文发现苏林依皱眉，有些犹豫，笑道：“好歹是高中同学，不会不欢迎我吧。”

    “不欢迎！”只不过苏林依没有说话，孙依诗却直接不耐烦的说话了，这顿饭是自己跟依依姐感谢木头哥请的饭局，多一个陌生人算怎么回事，所以孙依诗对于郑乔文的不依不挠十分反感。

    郑乔文脸色有些难看，孙依诗的话，他不在意，他在意的是孙依诗说完后，苏林依也没有站出来给他说话，也就是苏林依也同意了孙依诗的话。

    想让郑乔文放弃，自然不是那么容易的，郑乔文若无其事的说道：“大家都是老同学了，不用这么不给面子吧，这顿饭我请了，随你们怎么点菜。听说这家餐馆的消费挺贵的，一顿下来最低都要好几千吧，苏林依，你应该还在上学。。。”

    苏林依本来对郑乔文的印象还是不错的，只不过见到郑乔文没完没了，对他的印象也是直线下滑，郑乔文什么意思，她太清楚不过了。

    想了想，苏林依灵机一动，她先是看了眼陈木，发现陈木就在那若无其事的不知道在想什么，不由的有些气恼，作为自己的跟班，看到有人骚扰自己，竟然无动于衷？

    “对不起，郑乔文，我今天是陪我男朋友吃饭来的，所以真的不方便带你一起吃饭，实在不好意思。”苏林依走到陈木的旁边，微微拉着陈木的手臂。

    郑乔文闻言一愣，看向陈木，皱了皱眉，对着苏林依道

    “苏林依，你长这么漂亮，找男朋友一定要看清楚了，你找这样的男朋友，你父母知道吗，他做什么工作的，一年能赚多少钱？”
content_en:
"Sister Yiyi, let's go have lunch quickly, leave him alone." Sun Yishi couldn't help it when she saw that this person named Zheng Qiaowen kept chatting with Su Linyi, and said dissatisfiedly

"I'm sorry Zheng Qiaowen, we have to go to dinner. Goodbye." With that, Su Linyi pulled Sun Yishi and prepared to enter the restaurant.

However, Zheng Qiaowen finally met Su Linyi, so naturally he would not waste such an opportunity.

"Su Linyi, what a coincidence. I haven't had lunch either. Why don't we eat together? I'll treat you." Zheng Qiaowen said quickly

After a while, Zheng Qiaowen noticed that Su Linyi was frowning and hesitant, and said with a smile: "I am a high school classmate after all, so I won't be unwelcome."

"You're not welcome!" However, Su Linyi didn't say anything, but Sun Yishi spoke impatiently. This meal was a meal that she and Sister Yiyi thanked Brother Mu for inviting. What's the point of having another stranger, so Sun Yishi was very disgusted with Zheng Qiaowen's persistence.

Zheng Qiaowen looked a little ugly. He didn't care about Sun Yishi's words. What he cared about was that after Sun Yishi finished speaking, Su Linyi didn't stand up to speak to him, which meant that Su Linyi also agreed with Sun Yishi's words.

It's not easy to get Zheng Qiaowen to give up. Zheng Qiaowen said calmly: "We are all old classmates, so there is no need to be so disrespectful. I'm paying for this meal. You can order whatever you want. I heard that the food in this restaurant is quite expensive. A meal at least costs several thousand. Su Linyi, you should still be in school..."

Su Linyi originally had a good impression of Zheng Qiaowen, but after seeing Zheng Qiaowen endlessly, her impression of him also plummeted. She knew very well what Zheng Qiaowen meant.

After thinking about it, Su Linyi had an idea. She first glanced at Chen Mu and found that Chen Mu was there as if nothing had happened. She didn't know what he was thinking. She couldn't help but feel a little angry. As her follower, when she saw someone harassing her, she was indifferent?

"Sorry, Zheng Qiaowen, I came to have dinner with my boyfriend today, so it's really inconvenient to take you to dinner with me. I'm really sorry." Su Linyi walked to Chen Mu's side and pulled Chen Mu's arm slightly.

Zheng Qiaowen was stunned when he heard this, looked at Chen Mu, frowned, and said to Su Linyi

"Su Linyi, you are so beautiful. You must be careful when looking for a boyfriend. If you find such a boyfriend, do your parents know what kind of job he does and how much money he makes in a year?"
